moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio tumble-in, written here): Square (40 px) rolls in on a floor: x 0 → 175 px (demo 190) in 672 ms power2.out; rotation −180° → −24° over the same 672 ms (power1.out), then −24° → 0 in 148 ms power2.out (done at 820 ms). Its lowest corner stays on the floor: lift = half-size × (|cos θ| + |sin θ|). A dashed slot marks the end. Params: duration (0.82 s) · x (175 px) · rotation đầu (−180°) · move: thời gian đi (0.67 s). Its lowest corner stays on the floor: lift = half the size × (|cos θ| + |sin θ|) − half the size.
